description.value: The study characterized mGluR5 availability and neurodegeneration in behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia using [11C]ABP688 PET, [18F]FDG-PET, and voxel-based morphometry.

spans.text: The aim of the present study was to determine the availability of the metabotropic glutamate receptor type 5 (mGluR5) using a novel positron emission tomography (PET) radiopharmaceutical with high selectivity for mGluR5 ([11C]ABP688) in a sample of bvFTD patients.

description.value: Cross-sectional comparison of five patients with probable bvFTD and ten cognitively normal controls, using PET and MRI acquisitions.

spans.text: Exclusion criteria were (1) past or present use of memantine; (2) presence of other neurological diseases; (3) premorbid psychiatric disease or intellectual disability; (4) history of head injuries and loss of consciousness following head trauma; (5) current (within 1 month) use of psychoactive substances; (6) parkinsonism-as identified using the United Parkinson’s Disease Rating Scale (Goetz et al. 2007)-and (7) the presence of any major structural anomaly or signs of major vascular pathology on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)  evaluation (Roman et al. 1993).
